ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) base with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and linear formations, approximately a 70:30 dark-to-light distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) and circular clusters concentrated heavily on the distal regions (tips) and along the trailing edge. Centrally, the pigmentation transitions to a solid low-intensity dark gray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with a moderate depth-to-width ratio; approximately 80-90 degrees at the base vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations across both lobes. Significant jagged indentations and deep notches are visible on the left lobe (viewer perspective), while the right lobe shows more frequent, smaller-scale serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges transitioning into sharply tapered, upward-sloping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters resembling barnacle attachment sites are localized at the outer fluke tips and sporadically along the trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible upper fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe; high density of linear scarring across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined white ring/circular mark is visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
